title: Executive daily priorities - Priya Rao - 2026-03-04
content:
Quick scratchpad for the day - high priority items, meeting prep, follow-ups. Informal notes to self.

MORNING CHECKLIST
- 08:30 - EA catch-up (calendar prep + travel logistics).
- 09:00 - Exec leadership standup (15m) - quick status on Dedicated capacity launch readiness.
- 09:30 - 1:1 with CTO (Evan) - talking points: Dedicated pricing sensitivity, infra risk for Q2 rollouts, SLO defs.
- 10:30 - Sales / Legal sync re: FinCorp Dedicated pilot - confirm contract milestones, data residency clause, KMS requirements. Bring up fallback model variants if capacity spikes.

PRIORITIES THIS WEEK (top 3)
1) Finalize Dedicated pricing and SLA slide for Tuesday GTM sync - want clear commit tiers + burst policy.
2) Approve Private pilot contract template (legal edits done) so Solutions Eng can spin up first customer next week.
3) Sign-off on SRE runbook + oncall rota for new Dedicated pools (reduce blast radius).

MEETING PREP / TALKING POINTS
- Sales/Legal (10:30): confirm FinCorp security checklist items; prioritize KMS integration in scope; ask product to commit to 2-week pilot timeline; clarify termination/data return process.
- Product review (13:00): shipping plan for hosted API changes (streaming + rate limits); request short A/B test to measure RU impact of default batching.
- Customer call (14:30): FinCorp pilot kickoff - agenda: objectives, success metrics (latency targets, cost per req), support escalation path, timeline.

FOLLOW-UPS / ACTIONS (who, by when)
- Evan: get kernel selection doc link + perf telemetry samples for Q2 (by Fri).
- Maya (GTM): update pricing slide with commit tiers + example cost comparisons (by Mon).
- Legal (Nina): finish redlines on Private pilot agreement, flag any data-transfer clauses (by EOD).
- SRE (Jordan): draft runbook for Dedicated pool incidents and auto-failover steps (by Thu).

NOTES TO SELF / REMINDERS
- Keep board update slide short: 3 metrics (latency, cost/unit, uptime) + one customer story (FinCorp pilot).
- Check with infra on capacity headroom for next month; if < 20% we need to accelerate purchase/burst plan.
- Add a short note on cost controls to Redwood Optimize roadmap (start small: batching recommendations for top-5 customers).
- Remember to reply to Emma re: PRD comments on console tracing.

MISC SHORT ITEMS
- Approve time-off request from Sam (engineering) - block 2026-04-15 to 04-22.
- Quick note: schedule 30m sync with Solutions Eng to review onboarding checklist for Private deployments.

END-OF-DAY CHECK
- What shipped? any blocking issues? Did I escalate the SRE concern? Did Legal finish redlines?

Notes: rough bullets, will convert to formal follow-ups in Asana/Trello after calls.
